decisions.why: Carried from round 1, plan text unchanged. FR-002 asks for two seeded cases and leaves selection open; the pre-launch statement is FR-001's own instruction. Both counts (26 runs, 123 runs) re-run clean again this round from scripts/_agent_census.py --until 2026-09-19.

decisions.why: Carried from round 1, plan text unchanged. FR-002 specifies exactly this output and the contract instruction.

decisions.summary: One identical sentence placed under each of the seven contracts' opening paragraph, tested on the twin's verify-250-cr and verify-clean cases against R7's runs and the recorded runs.
decisions.why: Carried from round 1, plan text unchanged. FR-004 asks for one instruction in the same words in exactly those seven files, tested on two later spec-fidelity rounds on the twin.

decisions.summary: scripts/_source_pages.py promoted from 253's measure/fetch_text.py with a pointer|file|state manifest; the reader greps then reads around hits; URLs taken from each recorded prompt by the session, not by a model.
decisions.why: Carried from round 1, plan text unchanged. FR-006 asks for a no-model page saver and the grep-then-read contract, judged on R5's three cases.

decisions.summary: Haiku --agents probes, each MEASURING a subagent's first-turn input, varying one suspect at a time: CLAUDE.md (scratch copy with and without), the appended system prompt, the probe's tool list.
decisions.why: FR-007 asks for probe runs on the cheapest model dispatched inside this repository, with and without each suspect, and a recorded breakdown. The amended text states the measurement explicitly for each leg.

decisions.summary: The session memory index's contribution is MEASURED by a paired probe - the same probe run in a scratch copy of the repository (CLAUDE.md present, its own empty memory directory) and from /diagram (both present); a leg that cannot be run is a measured obstacle reported to the GM, never replaced by an estimate.
decisions.why: Round 1's NOT LEGITIMATE narrowing is gone. This is what FR-007 asks for - a probe that measures what the memory index adds to a subagent's first-turn input - and it closes the request's own open finding that what fills the 47-67 k fixed context 'was not established'. The character-count estimate and its pre-authorized fallback are removed, and the impossibility path now ends at the GM with a measurement rather than at a substitution.

decisions.summary: Memory index lines shortened to a hook of at most 120 characters, every entry kept; from an agent's tools: line, only a tool that NEITHER its recorded runs called (R9's per-tool counts) NOR its contract tells it to use.
decisions.why: FR-007 permits exactly two trims in these terms and this is both of them. Round 1's note is answered: the two-part test is how the plan establishes FR-007's 'a tool the check never calls' - a tool the contract tells the agent to use could be called in a case the recorded sample missed, so excluding it is evidence handling, not a narrowing. FR-007 grants permission to trim, not an obligation, so trimming fewer tools than the sample alone would allow removes nothing the request asked for.

decisions.summary: scripts/_review_facts.py runs in one call the measurements settlement-review.md's Tooling section already names and prints them together; two cases picked by seeded.py catalog from the smallest of the 123 recorded runs.
decisions.why: Carried from round 1, plan text unchanged. FR-005 asks for that script and two seeded runs; both named contract sections exist in the file.

decisions.summary: The Validated examples section moves UNCONDITIONALLY to docs/settlement-review-examples.md, outside .claude/agents/, and the contract names that path as the place to look when a finding of that kind is in doubt.
decisions.why: Round 1's NOT LEGITIMATE conditional drop is gone; the move now happens as FR-005 states it, to a file the agent is told to open only when a finding of that kind is in doubt. The collision is genuinely avoided rather than excused: test_agent_models.py builds its roster from AGENTS.glob('*.md') under .claude/agents/ (verified this round, line 54) and frontmatter() asserts on each, so a docs/ path leaves FR-008's 'test_agent_models.py is untouched' intact. Nothing in the request or the spec fixes the examples file's location.

decisions.summary: T01 source-entries, T02 scoped text, T03 batching line, T04 source-pages, T05 probes and trims, T06 review-facts, T07 record, T08 gates; each of T01-T06 ends with its batch scored and the candidate ADOPTED or NOT ADOPTED.
decisions.why: Carried from round 1, plan text unchanged. The spec's own assumption sets this cheapest-first order with settlement-review last, and SC-002 requires the per-candidate verdict.
